translated: K--T挻ㄐ Chuong 1 Tran chien cau bien gioi

original: 第一章界橋之戰
translated: Chuong 1 Tran chien cau bien gioi

original: 為討伐董卓而聚集的群雄，隨著聯軍解散，各自回到了自己的領地．聯軍主帥袁紹，用計奪取了韓馥的冀州，形成了以鄴城為據點的一大勢力．
translated: Cac anh hung tap hop lai de chinh phuc Dong Trac moi nguoi deu tro ve lanh tho cua minh khi lien minh tan ra. Vien Thieu tong tu lenh lien quan dung thu doan danh chiem Ky Chau cua Han Phuc va thanh lap dai the luc lay Nghiep thanh lam thanh tri.

original: 袁紹奪得冀州後，又開始盯上公孫瓚的領地．袁紹在位於與公孫瓚領地交界的界橋集結了大量兵力．
translated: Sau khi Vien Thieu chiem duoc Quy Chau, ong lai bat dau de mat toi lanh tho cua Cong Ton Zan. Vien Thieu tap trung mot so luong lon quan tai cau ranh gioi o bien gioi voi lanh tho cua Gongsun Zan.

original: 好，打垮公孫瓚！拿下北平的話，北面的半壁江山就成了我的了．分兵兩路進攻北平，張郃經巨鹿進攻，麴義經清河進攻．
translated: Duoc roi, danh bai Gongsun Zan! Neu ta chiem duoc Bac Binh, mot nua dat nuoc o phia bac se thuoc ve ta. Quan chia thanh hai nhom tan cong Bac Binh, Truong Anh tan cong qua Julu, va Qu Yi tan cong qua Qinghe.

original: 是！我馬上進攻巨鹿！
translated: Dung! Toi se tan cong Julu ngay lap tuc!

original: 那麼我發兵清河．
translated: Sau do ta se phai quan di don song.

original: 袁紹攻過來了！
translated: Vien Thieu toi roi!

original: 是的．從邊境的界橋出發，兵分清河、巨鹿兩路攻過來了．
translated: Dung. Bat dau tu cay cau bien gioi, quan tan cong tu Qinghe va Julu.

original: 唉……．那麼嚴綱，你率軍去清河，我進軍巨鹿．最終的目標是界橋．殺死袁紹．
translated: Tot……. Vay Yen Cuong, nguoi dan quan den Thanh Ha, ta se tien quan den Julu. Muc tieu cuoi cung la cay cau ranh gioi. Giet Vien Thieu.

original: 是！
translated: Dung!

original: 平原議事廳
translated: phong hoi dong don gian

original: 兄長，公孫瓚軍和袁紹軍已經對峙了很長時間了．
translated: Huynh de, quan cua Cong Ton Zan va quan cua Vien Thieu da doi dau voi nhau tu lau roi.

original: 就要這樣一直對峙下去？
translated: Ban co muon tiep tuc doi dau nhu the nay khong?

original: 不會的，現在雙方都在展開情報戰，不久就會打起來的．
translated: Khong, ca hai ben hien dang phat dong mot cuoc chien tinh bao va se som xay ra mot cuoc chien.

original: 哼，我不懂．
translated: Hu, toi khong hieu.

original: 蠢貨！作為大將光靠武力不行．智勇雙全的人才是真正的大將，是吧．兄長．
translated: ke ngoc! La mot vi tuong, ban khong the chi dua vao vu luc. Chi co nhung nguoi khon ngoan va dung cam moi la nhung vi tuong thuc su phai khong? Anh trai.

original: 當然是．
translated: Tat nhien roi.

original: 哎，那麼大哥也總是搞那種什麼情報戰？
translated: Nay, vay la anh ca luon tham gia vao cuoc chien tinh bao kieu do a?

original: 當然．現在我就想去巡視城內，從居民那裡打探些情報．
translated: chac chan. Bay gio toi chi muon tuan tra thanh pho va lay mot so thong tin tu nguoi dan.

original: 不愧是兄長．好事要快辦．我和張飛看家，有事的話會去叫你．
translated: Anh ay xung dang la mot nguoi anh trai. Nhung dieu tot nen duoc thuc hien mot cach nhanh chong. Toi va Truong Phi se trong nha va se goi cho ban neu co chuyen gi xay ra.

original: 城裡有酒館等居民聚集的地方，想從居民那裡得到情報，還是去人多的地方好．
translated: Co nhung quan ruou va nhung noi khac trong thanh pho noi cu dan tu tap. Neu muon lay thong tin tu nguoi dan, tot hon het ban nen den noi dong nguoi.

original: 有什麼事的話會去叫你．
translated: Toi se goi cho ban neu co chuyen gi xay ra.

original: 兄長，來了個叫簡雍的人，說是來見兄長．
translated: Anh a, mot nguoi dan ong ten la Jian Yong da den va noi rang anh ay den gap anh trai.

original: 請兄長講話．
translated: Hay noi di, nguoi anh em.

original: 我不太清楚，大哥想個辦法吧．
translated: Toi khong chac. Anh em hay nghi cach di.

original: 劉備，我叫簡雍．久仰您的大名，此次特地前來投靠，請您收下我．
translated: Luu Bi, toi ten la Kien Dung. Toi da nguong mo ten tuoi cua ban tu lau va toi dac biet den day de tim noi an nau voi ban. Hay chap nhan toi.

original: l劉備，突然拜訪．我是公孫瓚派來的使者，請求您派兵支援．
translated: l Luu Bi, mot chuyen vieng tham bat ngo. Toi la su gia duoc Gongsun Zan cu den, yeu cau ban gui quan den ho tro toi.

original: 請聽使者講話．
translated: Hay lang nghe su gia.

original: 公孫瓚出了什麼事了嗎？
translated: Chuyen gi da xay ra voi Gongsun Zan?

original: 使者啊！聽說袁紹軍從界橋正不斷向東進軍……
translated: Tin nhan! Nghe noi quan Vien Thieu dang tien ve phia dong tu cau bien gioi...

original: l是的．袁紹軍已經攻佔我們很多領土，現還在向縱深發展．我們主公已從北平出兵了．
translated: toi vang. Quan Vien Thieu da chiem duoc rat nhieu lanh tho cua ta va con dang phat trien ve chieu sau. Lanh chua cua chung toi da gui quan tu Bac Binh.

original: 那麼戰況如何？
translated: Vay cuoc chien dien ra nhu the nao?

original: l主公率領的主力部隊在界橋作戰，公孫越軍和嚴綱軍分別在巨鹿和清河作戰，但形勢都不太好．劉備，請你支援我們．
translated: l Quan chu luc do Lanh chua chi huy danh o Jieqiao, trong khi quan cua Gongsun Yue va quan cua Yan Gang lan luot danh o Julu va Qinghe, nhung tinh hinh khong may kha quan. Luu Bi Hay ung ho chung toi nhe.

original: 公孫瓚有危險了，大哥，快去支援吧．
translated: Gongsun Zan dang gap nguy hiem, anh trai, hay nhanh chong ho tro anh ay.

original: 唉，使者你回去對公孫瓚說我們馬上就去支援．
translated: Than oi, su gia hay quay lai noi voi Gongsun Zan rang chung toi se den ho tro anh ay ngay lap tuc.

original: l噢，謝謝．
translated: O, cam on ban.

original: 主公，去界橋的話，從平原走有兩條路，一條經過廣川，一條經過信都城．
translated: Thua ngai, neu ngai muon den Jieqiao, tu Pingyuan co hai con duong, mot di qua Quang Xuyen va mot di qua thanh pho Xindu.

original: 唉，廣川和信都城啊，應該走哪條呢？
translated: Cha, thanh pho Quang Xuyen va Tan Do, toi nen di cai nao?

original: 走信都城的話，到界橋有些繞遠路，不過有道具屋，補充足一些好．
translated: Neu di den thanh pho Tan Do, duong den Jieqiao se rat xa, nhung co cua hang dao cu nen bo sung them cung tot.

original: 還在說啊，再不快點去支援的話，公孫瓚豈不危險了．大哥快去支援吧．
translated: Anh ay van dang noi, neu anh ay khong nhanh chong den ho tro, Gongsun Zan se khong gap nguy hiem sao? Anh em vao ung ho em nhe.

original: 準備好的話叫我一聲，我現在去道具屋買些兵器．
translated: Hay goi cho toi khi ban da san sang. Bay gio toi se den cua hang dao cu de mua mot so vu khi.

original: 我覺得公孫瓚的據點北平有賣兵器的，北平在平原的北面．
translated: Toi nghi co nhung nguoi ban vu khi o thanh tri cua Gongsun Zan o Peiping, phia bac dong bang.

original: 準備好了嗎？
translated: Ban da san sang chua?

original: 那麼出發吧．
translated: Vay thi di thoi.

original: 快出發吧．
translated: Hay di nhanh len.

original: 從這裡去界橋，要路過廣川或信都城中的一個．
translated: De den Jieqiao tu day, ban phai di qua thanh pho Quang Xuyen hoac Tan Do.

original: 兄長，你要走廣川這條路，還是走信都城這條路？
translated: Anh oi, anh muon di duong Quang Xuyen hay duong Tan Do Thanh?

original: 那麼走廣川吧，列隊．
translated: Vay thi chung ta hay den Quang Xuyen va xep hang.

original: 逢紀，你去廣川．擾亂公孫瓚的背後．
translated: Da den luc phai den Quang Xuyen. Pha vo lung cua Gongsun Zan.

original: 是．
translated: Dung.

original: 將士們，我們繞道公孫瓚背後去，進軍廣川！
translated: Cac binh si, hay di vong ra phia sau Gongsun Zan va tien ve phia Quang Xuyen!

original: 什麼！袁紹軍要襲擊我們的背後？壞了！如果這樣的話，我們就進攻袁紹的大本營！進攻界橋！
translated: Cai gi! Quan Vien Thieu sap danh sau lung ta? vo! Neu vay thi chung ta se tan cong can cu cua Vien Thieu! Tan cong cau ranh gioi!

original: 向廣川進軍吧！
translated: Thang ba den Quang Xuyen!

original: 走信都城吧，列隊！
translated: Hay den thanh pho Xindu va xep hang!

original: 淳于瓊，你去信都城，攪亂公孫瓚的背後．
translated: Chunyu Qiong, hay den thanh pho Xindu va gay rac roi sau lung Gongsun Zan.

original: 將士們！我們繞到公孫瓚的背後去攻打信都城！跟上！
translated: Nhung nguoi linh! Chung ta vong ra sau lung Gongsun Zan va tan cong thanh pho Xindu! Theo kip!

original: 向信都城進軍吧！
translated: Hay hanh quan ve phia thanh pho Xindu!

original: 廣川戰場
translated: chien truong Quang Xuyen

original: 那是？兄長，像是袁紹軍．
translated: Do la? Anh em nhu quan Vien Thieu ay.

original: 什麼，袁紹軍！袁紹軍正與公孫瓚軍打仗呢，為什麼出現在這裡？
translated: Cai gi, quan Vien Thieu! Quan Vien Thieu giao chien voi quan cua Gongsun Zan. Tai sao ho lai o day?

original: 既然袁紹軍到達這裡，恐怕公孫瓚軍已被打敗了．
translated: Bay gio quan Vien Thieu da den day, e rang quan cua Cong Ton Zan da bai tran.

original: 什麼，有軍隊？誰的軍隊？噢，原來是平原的劉備軍，是去支援公孫瓚的．本來是在這裡布陣，打公孫瓚的背後．也好就打劉備．將士們，迎擊劉備軍．
translated: Cai gi, mot doi quan a? Quan doi cua ai? O, hoa ra la quan Luu Bi tu Binh Nguyen den ho tro Cong Ton Zan. Ban dau, doi hinh duoc bo tri o day de tan cong vao lung Gongsun Zan. Cu goi cho Luu Bi. Cac binh si hay tan cong quan cua Luu Bi.

original: 大哥，袁紹軍打過來了．
translated: Anh oi quan Vien Thieu dang toi.

original: 既然打過來了，就教訓教訓他．
translated: Bay gio han da bi danh, hay day cho han mot bai hoc.

original: 對面的主將聽著，關羽要與你們決一勝負！
translated: Tuong quan doi dien nghe, Quan Vu muon danh nguoi de gianh thang loi!

original: 好，放馬過來！
translated: Duoc roi, toi day nao!

original: 你叫什麼名字？
translated: Toi co the biet ten cua ban duoc khong?

original: 我叫關羽關雲長．
translated: Toi ten la Quan Vu Quan Van Xuong.

original: 關羽……？什麼！是關羽？是那個大名遠揚的關羽？
translated: Quan Vu…? Cai gi! Quan Vu phai khong? Co phai la Quan Vu noi tieng?

original: 噢，知道我的名字啊，那麼某種程度上也知道我的厲害吧．
translated: O, ban biet ten toi nen ban cung biet toi manh den muc nao o mot muc do nao do.

original: 放屁！殺啊！
translated: xi hoi! Giet!

original: 不愧是擊敗呂布軍的英雄……實在打不過．
translated: Anh ta xung dang la nguoi hung da danh bai quan doi cua Lu Bo... Anh ta thuc su khong the danh bai ho.

original: 看刀！
translated: Hay nhin con dao!

original: 噢！再也堅持不了啦，既然是關羽，我還是快逃吧．
translated: O! Toi khong the giu duoc nua. Da la Quan Vu thi tot nhat toi nen chay tron.

original: 這廣川也只好放棄了．全軍撤退！
translated: Quang Xuyen khong con cach nao khac danh phai bo cuoc. Toan quan rut lui!

original: 唉，劉備軍相當厲害！廣川也只好放棄了，全軍撤退！
translated: Than oi, quan Luu Bi kha hung manh! Quang Xuyen khong con cach nao khac danh phai bo cuoc va rut lui!

original: 繳獲了黃金２００！
translated: 200 vang bi tich thu!

original: 廣川營帳
translated: Trai Quang Xuyen

original: 兄長，袁紹軍好像敗退了．
translated: Anh oi, quan Vien Thieu coi nhu da bai tran.

original: 唉，可是袁紹軍都來到這裡了，我看好像不妙啊．
translated: Than oi, nhung quan Vien Thieu co mat o day, toi khong nghi la se on dau.

original: 像是不妙，嗯？主公，好像有人來．
translated: Giong nhu co gi do khong on phai khong? Chua oi, hinh nhu co ai do dang den.

original: 劉備，請原諒冒昧來訪．我們是信都城的武將，我叫韓英．
translated: Luu Bi xin thu loi cho toi ghe tham. Chung toi la tuong quan tu thanh pho Xindu. Toi ten la Han Anh.

original: 我叫郭適，初次與你見面．
translated: Ten toi la Guo Shi, va day la lan dau tien toi gap ban.

original: 你們為什麼還要到這裡來？
translated: Tai sao ban van den day?
abbrev: Tai sao ban van den day?

original: 信都城被袁紹佔領了，我們倆是奉命守城的．因袁紹軍攻勢猛烈……
translated: Thanh Tan Do bi Vien Thieu chiem, chung toi duoc lenh tran thu thanh. Truoc su tan cong ac liet cua quan Vien Thieu...

original: 是被袁紹手下淳于瓊攻陷了．
translated: No bi thuoc ha cua Vien Thieu la Chunyu Qiong bat giu.

original: 什麼！袁紹都攻到信都城來了？
translated: Cai gi! Vien Thieu da tan cong thanh Tan Do?

original: 是的，之後我們聽說劉備軍前來支援，所以投奔你們來了．
translated: Dung, sau nay chung toi nghe tin quan Luu Bi den ho tro nen chung toi den tim ban.

original: 如此讓袁紹為所欲為，也太令人心灰意冷了．劉備，請讓我們加入吧．
translated: That buc minh khi de Vien Thieu muon lam gi thi lam. Luu Bi, hay cho chung toi tham gia nhe.

original: 我一定要報此仇，請讓我們加入吧．
translated: Toi phai tra thu viec nay, xin hay cho chung toi tham gia.

original: 大哥就讓他們加入吧．也怪可憐的．
translated: Anh em oi, hay de ho tham gia. That dang thuong.

original: 你們倆個加入我軍，我們的陣營又強大了．好好幹吧！
translated: Neu hai ban gia nhap quan doi cua chung toi, trai cua chung toi se manh me tro lai. Di cho no!

original: 謝謝．
translated: Cam on.

original: 請看我們的表現吧．
translated: Xin hay xem hieu suat cua chung toi.

original: 陣容也強大了，快去救援吧．
translated: Doi hinh cung manh, ra ung cuu nhanh di.

original: 簡雍，這裡離界橋很近了吧？
translated: Jian Yong, noi nay co rat gan cau Jie khong?

original: 還不近，從這裡去界橋有兩條路，一條經過清河，另一條經過巨鹿．
translated: No van chua den gan. Tu day co hai con duong den Jieqiao, mot di qua Qinghe va mot di qua Julu.

original: 清河和巨鹿，走哪條路都通往界橋嗎？
translated: Qinghe va Julu, con duong nao dan den Jieqiao?

original: 是的．
translated: Dung.

original: 可是，袁紹軍既然已來到了這裡，那裡也會有敵人吧．
translated: Tuy nhien, vi quan Vien Thieu da den day nen o do chac chan co dich.

original: 有就有吧，我來解決他們．
translated: Neu vay hay de toi giai quyet chung.

original: 快準備出征吧．我叫來了刀匠，你們選用吧．
translated: Hay san sang tham chien. Toi da goi cho tho lam dao, ban co the chon.

original: 大哥，快走吧，我已經憋不住了．
translated: Anh oi, thoi nao, em khong the nhin duoc nua.

original: 出征前有兩件事要準備，一是買些武器，二是做好記錄．
translated: Truoc khi ra ngoai co hai viec can chuan bi, mot la mua mot it vu khi, hai la ghi chep.

original: 我要努力殺敵，下命令吧．
translated: Toi muon lam viec cham chi de tieu diet ke thu. Dua toi menh lenh.

original: 出發吧！
translated: Di thoi!

original: 大哥，清河和巨鹿去哪裡？快決定．
translated: Anh oi, Qinghe va Julu di dau vay? Quyet dinh nhanh chong.

original: 信都城
translated: Thanh pho Tan Do

original: 就要守不住了……袁紹軍怎麼會在這兒出現．
translated: Chung ta khong the phong thu duoc nua... Tai sao quan Vien Thieu lai xuat hien o day?

original: 好．信都城快攻下來了，大家再加把勁．
translated: Tot. Thanh pho Tan Do sap bi chiem, chung ta hay co gang hon nua nhe.

original: 兄長，好像是袁紹軍．信都城遭到袁紹軍的襲擊．
translated: Anh oi hinh nhu la quan Vien Thieu. Thanh Tan Do bi quan Vien Thieu tan cong.

original: 袁紹軍怎麼會打到這裡來呢？公孫瓚怎麼樣了呢？
translated: Quan Vien Thieu den day bang cach nao? Gongsun Zan the nao roi?

original: 唉，那是哪兒的部隊？像是平原劉備的部隊，劉備部隊怎麼來到這裡？不管他，在此殺掉劉備！全軍！向劉備軍出擊．
translated: Than oi, doi quan do o dau? Giong nhu quan cua Luu Bi o dong bang, quan cua Luu Bi lam the nao ma den duoc day? Mac ke han, giet Luu Bi tai day! Toan quan! Danh quan Luu Bi.

original: 大哥，袁紹軍殺過來了．
translated: Anh oi quan Vien Thieu dang toi.

original: 兄長，救信都城吧．只要能守住信都城，袁紹軍就得撤退．向城門打吧！
translated: Anh oi, hay cuu thanh pho Xindu. Chi can co the phong thu duoc thanh Sindu thi quan Vien Thieu se phai rut lui. Chien dau o cong thanh!

original: 哪個是主將？喂，我是張飛，哪個與我單挑較量！
translated: Tuong nao la tuong? Nay, toi la Truong Phi, thach dau tay doi voi toi!

original: 好，正中下懷．
translated: Duoc roi, dung nhu nhung gi toi muon.

original: 張飛！殺！
translated: Truong Phi! giet!

original: 這……！這麼厲害……
translated: cai nay……! That manh me...

original: 就這點兒能耐，贏不了我！
translated: Voi kha nang nho be nay, ban khong the danh bai toi!

original: 打不過他．媽的，沒辦法，走為上．
translated: Khong the danh bai anh ta. Chet tiet, khong con cach nao khac, cach tot nhat la di.

original: 繳獲黃金１００！
translated: 100 vang bi tich thu!

original: 他媽的，再加把勁就能攻下來，可是只好全軍撤退！
translated: Chet tiet, neu co gang hon nua toi co the bat duoc no, nhung toan bo quan doi phai rut lui!

original: 繳獲黃軍２００！
translated: Bat duoc 200 Hoang quan!

original: 兄長，袁紹軍好像退兵了．
translated: Anh oi quan Vien Thieu hinh nhu da rut lui roi.

original: 唉，可是袁紹軍竟能派一隻軍隊到這裡，戰況好像不妙啊．
translated: Than oi, nhung quan Vien Thieu da dua duoc quan vao day. Tinh hinh tran chien co ve khong on.

original: 好像不妙，先進信都城吧．
translated: No co ve khong tot. Chung ta hay den thu do truoc.

original: 信都議事廳
translated: Hoi quan Tan Do

original: 劉備，您救了信都，太謝謝你了．
translated: Luu Bi, ban da cuu Xindu, cam on ban rat nhieu.

original: 不用謝．還好，我們正好經過信都．
translated: Khong co gi. May man thay, chung toi tinh co di qua Xindu.

original: 我們這是去支援公孫瓚，剛才要從信都過去，發現你這裡受到攻擊．
translated: Chung toi se ho tro Gongsun Zan. Vua roi chung toi dang di tu Xindu va phat hien ra rang ban dang bi tan cong.

original: 哦，……劉備，請讓我也加入援軍以報答您救信都之恩．
translated: Oi,... Luu Bi, xin hay cho toi gia nhap quan tiep vien de bao dap on cuu Tan Do cua anh.

original: 那麼，兄長，我們快去支援吧．準備好的話請說一聲．
translated: The thi anh em hay di ung ho anh ay nhanh nhe. Xin vui long cho toi biet neu ban da san sang.

original: 主公，出發前要不要去打製兵器的道具屋看一看？
translated: Chua oi, ban co muon den cua hang dung cu noi che tao vu khi truoc khi khoi hanh khong?

original: 大哥，再不出發也許就來不及了．
translated: Anh a, neu anh khong bat dau ngay bay gio thi co the da qua muon.

original: 我也參加你們的援軍．
translated: Toi cung se tham gia tiep vien cua ban.

original: 兄長，快去支援吧．
translated: Anh em di ung ho nhe.
abbrev: Anh em di ung ho nhe.

original: 簡雍，這裡到界橋很近了吧？
translated: Jian Yong, no co rat gan voi Jieqiao khong?

original: 還不近．這裡到界橋有兩條路，一條經過清河，另一條經過巨鹿．
translated: Van chua gan. O day co hai con duong den Jieqiao, mot di qua Qinghe va mot di qua Julu.

original: 清河和巨鹿啊．走哪條路都通過界橋嗎？
translated: Qinghe va Julu. Ban co di qua cay cau ranh gioi bat ke ban di theo huong nao khong?

original: 可是，袁紹軍既然派兵到了這裡，那裡也會有敵人吧．
translated: Tuy nhien, vi quan Vien Thieu da dua quan toi day nen o do chac chan co giac.

original: 有就有吧．我來解決他們．大哥，清河和巨鹿，你選擇哪條路？快決定吧．
translated: Vang, vang. Toi se giai quyet chung. Anh, Qinghe hay Julu, anh chon con duong nao? Quyet dinh nhanh chong.

original: 明白了，那麼去巨鹿吧．
translated: Hieu roi, vay hay den gap Julu.

original: 明白了，那麼去清河吧．
translated: Hieu roi, vay chung ta hay den Qinghe.

original: 好像是敵人，列隊．
translated: Nhu the ho la ke thu, ho xep hang.

original: 麴義！我嚴綱要和你單挑較量！
translated: Quyi! Toi, Yan Gang, muon thach dau voi ban mot tran dau tay doi!

original: 有膽量，但你要倒霉啦！你還覺得能打贏我麴義？殺啊！
translated: Ban co can dam, nhung ban se khong gap may! Ban van nghi rang ban co the danh bai toi, Qu Yi? Giet!

original: 嚴綱，看刀！
translated: Yen Cuong, nhin con dao nay!

original: 哎呀！
translated: Oi!

original: 公孫瓚的大將嚴綱被斬了！
translated: Tuong Yan Gang cua Gongsun Zan bi chat dau!

original: 大哥，好像晚了一步嚴綱被斬，清河北平軍潰敗了．
translated: Anh oi, xem ra Yan Gang da bi chat dau qua muon, va quan Qinghe va Bac Kinh da bi danh bai.

original: 晚了一步啊，好！血債要用血來還！
translated: Da muon mot buoc roi, duoc chu! No mau phai tra bang mau!

original: 嗯？那不是劉備軍嗎？噢，想去支援公孫瓚．我麴義不讓你們去！
translated: Um? Do khong phai la quan Luu Bi sao? O, toi muon di ung ho Gongsun Zan. Toi, Qu Yi, se khong de ban di!

original: 這裡的大將聽著！我要和你單挑較量！
translated: Tuong quan day, nghe day! Ta muon dau mot choi mot voi nguoi!

original: 什麼？竟還有人敢向我挑戰！好吧，就與你鬥一鬥！
translated: Cai gi? Van co nguoi dam thach thuc ta! Duoc roi, hay chien dau voi ban!

original: 讓你也和剛才的嚴綱落個同樣下場！
translated: Hay de ban ket thuc voi so phan giong nhu Yan Gang vua roi!

original: 好傢伙！好厲害……
translated: Anh chang tot! That tuyet voi...

original: 強中自有強中手，算你倒霉，砍下你的首級．
translated: Ke manh se co ban tay manh me cua rieng minh. Ta se coi nguoi la ke xui xeo va chat dau nguoi.
Tai sao……!

original: 我的武藝也不夠嫻熟，這麼個小對手竟感到有點難對付……
translated: Vo cong cua ta khong du tot, doi pho voi doi thu nho be nhu vay co chut kho khan...

original:
關羽殺了麴義，
　劉備軍突破了清河．
translated:
Quan Vu giet Qu Yi;
Quan cua Luu Bi dot pha Thanh Ha.

original: 嗯！那是！？
translated: Um! Do la! ?

original: 喂，劉備！休想從這裡過去．
translated: Chao Luu Bi! Dung nghi den viec vuot qua day.

original: 繳獲了黃金１００！
translated: 100 vang bi tich thu!

original: 什麼！清河的麴義被公孫瓚軍突破了，沒辦法．撤回主公坐鎮的界橋！
translated: Cai gi! Qu Yi o Qinghe da bi quan cua Gongsun Zan choc thung luoi va anh ta khong the lam gi duoc. Hay rut cay cau ranh gioi noi chua dong quan!

original: 媽的，我的兵力再強大一點，就能捉住張郃．
translated: Me kiep, neu quan cua ta manh hon, ta co the bat duoc Zhang He.

original: 前面就是袁紹主力所在的界橋！
translated: Phia truoc la cau ranh gioi noi dong quan chu luc cua Vien Thieu!

original: 大哥快去界橋吧！
translated: Anh oi, hay den Jieqiao nhanh len!

original: 張郃，快些收拾掉北平軍，趕快和界橋的主力會合吧．
translated: Zhang He, hay nhanh chong loai bo quan Peiping va gia nhap luc luong chinh tai Jieqiao cang som cang tot.

original: 唉，可是我聽說公孫瓚的盟友劉備軍打敗了我軍的一支勁旅，正向巨鹿趕來，一定得設法不讓公孫瓚和劉備匯合．
translated: Than oi, toi nghe noi quan Luu Bi, dong minh cua Gongsun Zan, da danh bai mot the luc hung hau cua quan ta va dang tien ve phia Julu. Toi phai co gang ngan can Gongsun Zan va Luu Bi hop luc.

original: 公孫越，平原劉備前來助戰．
translated: Gongsun Yue va Pingyuan Luu Bi den ho tro trong tran chien.

original: 哦，是劉備，我們有救了．諸位，援軍來了．
translated: O, la Luu Bi, chung ta duoc cuu roi. Moi nguoi, quan tiep vien dang den.

original: 來了，啊．劉備！我張郃在此擋路，你去不了界橋．
translated: Chung ta den day, a. Luu Bi! Toi, Zhang He, dang chan duong o day, vi vay ban khong the den cau ranh gioi.

original: 關羽！張飛！你們敢與我顏良交戰嗎？
translated: Quan Vu! Truong Phi! Nhan Luong nguoi co dam dau voi ta khong?

original: 大哥，敵人好像比想像的要厲害．現在我們不應該在這裡與敵人廝殺，而要衝開敵人陣地突出去．慶幸的是山下西面有一個鹿砦，如果我們摸到那裡，敵人也就束手無策了．
translated: Anh em oi, ke thu co ve manh hon tuong tuong. Bay gio chung ta khong nen chien dau voi ke thu o day ma hay dot pha vao vi tri cua ke thu va noi bat. May man thay, co mot lang huou duoi chan nui ve phia tay. Neu chung ta cham vao do, ke thu se bat luc.

original: 噢，看樣子是個很厲害的對手嘛．我去對付他．
translated: O, anh ta trong co ve la mot doi thu rat manh. Toi se giai quyet anh ta.

original: 你是何人？朝這邊來是要和我交戰嗎？好哇，殺！
translated: Ban la ai? Cau toi day de dau voi toi a? Duoc roi, giet di!

original: 好像還有兩下子，碰上我算你倒霉．
translated: Xem ra van con chut thoi gian nua, neu dung phai toi thi that xui xeo.

original: 讓你嚐嚐這一刀．
translated: Hay de ban thu con dao nay.

original: 你玩的什麼武藝？這樣還能贏我？
translated: Ban dang tap mon vo thuat nao? Ban van co the thang toi chu?

original: 唉，連我這一刀也躲過去了，好厲害的傢伙．
translated: Than oi, ngay ca con dao cua toi cung ne duoc, that la mot ke manh me.

original: 你就這點本事啊．
translated: Do la tat ca nhung gi ban co.

original: 噢噢！打不過他，逃吧！
translated: O o! Danh khong lai han thi chay di!

original: 唉！那是！？
translated: Tot! Do la! ?

original: 什麼？從前面也來了嗎！？
translated: Cai gi? Ban cung den tu phia truoc a? ?

original: 我是關純，原是韓馥的部下．此番前來加入劉備軍．
translated: Toi la Quan Xuan, truoc day la thuoc ha cua Han Phuc. Hay den va gia nhap quan doi Luu Bi lan nay.

original: 我們的主公韓馥被袁紹詐佔了冀州，此仇難忘，我耿武也前來加入劉備軍．
translated: Han Phuc chua ta bi Vien Thieu lua chiem Cat Chau. Moi thu nay that kho quen. Toi, Geng Wu, cung den gia nhap quan Luu Bi.

original: 那是哪兒的軍隊？
translated: Doi quan do o dau?

original: 那的確是關純和耿武，他們是被袁紹詐佔了冀州的韓馥的部下．
translated: Do thuc su la Guan Chun va Geng Wu. Ho chinh la thuoc ha cua Han Phuc bi Vien Thieu lua chiem Ki Chau.

original: 噢，是要報仇吧．
translated: Oi, toi muon tra thu.

original: 大概是吧．
translated: Co le vay.

original: 總之不是敵人吧？那麼就是我們的援軍了．
translated: Rot cuoc, ho khong phai la ke thu, phai khong? Sau do la quan tiep vien cua chung toi.

original: 媽的！敗給了劉備！撤退！
translated: Oi chet tiet! thua Luu Bi roi! rut lui!

original: 好，我軍勝利了！
translated: Duoc roi, quan doi cua chung ta da thang!

original: 不能讓劉備突破巨鹿，全軍阻擋劉備！
translated: Luu Bi khong duoc phep dot pha Julu, toan quan chan Luu Bi!

original: 大哥，鹿砦就在眼前，想辦法衝過去吧．
translated: Anh oi, Luzhai dang o ngay truoc mat chung ta. Tim cach lao toi.

original: 媽的！不能讓劉備過去！
translated: Oi chet tiet! Khong the de Luu Bi vuot qua!

original: 好，突破巨鹿了．
translated: Duoc roi, chung ta da vuot qua duoc Julu.

original: 什麼？巨鹿的張郃被公孫瓚軍突破了？沒辦法，只好返回主公坐鎮的界橋．
translated: Cai gi? Zhang He cua Julu da bi quan cua Gongsun Zan choc thung luoi? Khong con lua chon nao khac ngoai viec quay tro lai cay cau ranh gioi noi lanh chua dong quan.

original: 媽的，要是我武力再強點的話，就能捉住麴義了．
translated: Chet tiet, neu luc luong cua toi manh hon, toi co the bat duoc Qu Yi.

original: 劉備，我原是韓馥的下屬，叫關純．
translated: Luu Bi, ta von la thuoc ha cua Han Phuc, ten la Quan Xuan.

original: 我叫耿武．
translated: Ten toi la Canh Vu.

original: 唉．
translated: Tot.

original: 我們的主公韓馥，被袁紹奪去了冀州，現在鄉下默默的生活．我們還沒向袁紹報仇雪恨，劉備，請帶我們一起走．
translated: Nhan vat chinh Han Fu cua chung ta da bi Vien Thieu tuoc doat khoi Ky Chau va hien song am tham o vung nong thon. Chung toi chua bao thu cho Vien Thieu, Luu Bi, xin hay dua chung toi di cung.

original: 明白了，那就跟我走吧．
translated: Hieu roi thi di voi toi.

original: 是，謝謝劉備．
translated: Vang, cam on Luu Bi.

original: 大哥，快去界橋吧．
translated: Anh oi, hay den Jieqiao nhanh len.

original: 大哥，到界橋了，請列隊．
translated: Anh oi chung ta da toi cau ranh gioi roi. Hay xep hang.

original: 敵軍已經不堪一擊．文醜！去取公孫瓚的首級！
translated: Quan dich da de bi ton thuong. Van Chau! Di lay dau cua Gongsun Zan!

original: 我乃文醜，公孫瓚，明年的今天就是你的忌日．
translated: Toi la Van Chau, Gongsun Zan. Hom nay nam sau se la ngay gio cua ban.

original: 怎麼搞的！援軍還沒有到啊．
translated: Chuyen gi da xay ra the! Quan tiep vien van chua den.

original: 主公，這交給我吧．文醜來受死吧！
translated: Lay Chua, hay de viec nay cho con. Den chet di Van Chau!

original: 噓，無名小卒，快滾回去吧．
translated: Im di, nguoi vo danh, quay lai nhanh di.
giet……

original: 太、太厲害了．
translated: Vi vay, that tuyet voi.

original: 哈哈哈，怎麼樣！憑你這點兒本事想贏我！
translated: Hahaha, the thi sao! Ban muon danh bai toi bang kha nang nho be cua ban!

original: 公孫瓚，哪裡走！納命來！
translated: Gongsun Zan, ban dang di dau vay? Hay lay di mang song cua ban!

original: 看來我命到此休矣！
translated: Cuoc doi toi coi nhu xong roi!

original: 等一下，這次我來戰你．
translated: Cho mot chut, lan nay ta se dau voi nguoi.

original: 你是何人？
translated: Ban la ai?

original: 不知死活的傢伙，和公孫瓚一起作我槍下之鬼吧．
translated: Cac ban chua biet song hay chet hay cung Gongsun Zan tro thanh nan nhan cua phat sung cua toi nhe.
Oi! !

original: 哦！殺啊！媽的，好厲害，先撤吧．
translated: O! Giet! Chet tiet, no manh qua. Hay rut lui truoc.

original: 哦，剛才差一點沒了命，真是太感謝你了，讓我說聲謝謝吧，請問大名．
translated: Oi, vua roi toi suyt chet. Cam on ban rat nhieu. Hay de toi noi loi cam on. Toi co the hoi ten ban duoc khong?

original: 我叫趙雲．
translated: Toi ten Trieu Van.

original: 以前跟隨袁紹，我看透了他既不忠君也不愛惜百姓，就要離開他，返回故鄉．
translated: Toi da tung theo Vien Thieu. Toi thay ro anh ay khong trung thanh voi hoang de, cung khong quan tam den dan chung nen toi muon roi xa anh ay va tro ve que huong.

original: 袁紹幹了件蠢事啊，怎麼樣，你能不能幫助我．
translated: Vien Thieu da lam dieu gi do ngu ngoc, con chuyen do thi sao, ban co the giup toi duoc khong?

original: 好！
translated: Tot!

original: 嗯？公孫瓚，那支軍隊是？
translated: Um? Gongsun Zan, do la doi quan nao?

original: 噢，那是平原劉備的軍隊啊！諸位，劉備的援軍到了！
translated: O, ro rang la quan cua Luu Bi! Moi nguoi, quan tiep vien cua Luu Bi da toi!

original: 大哥，好像趕上了．
translated: Anh oi, co ve nhu em da bat kip roi.

original: 聽說公孫瓚正在打仗，我特地從平原趕來助戰．
translated: Toi nghe noi Gongsun Zan dang danh giac nen toi da tu vung dong bang den giup anh ay chien dau.

original: 大哥，敵軍強大，我們去襲擊敵人的糧倉吧．
translated: Anh oi, quan giac manh lam, chung ta hay tan cong vua lua cua giac.

original: 主公，劉備軍來了．
translated: Chua oi, quan Luu Bi dang toi.

original: 哎呀，是那個劉備軍嗎？
translated: Oi, quan Luu Bi phai khong?

original: 主公，怕什麼，不能放過這次機會．
translated: Lay Chua, Ngai so dieu gi? Ban khong the de co hoi nay troi qua.

original: ……對了，好，一起殺死他們祭旗！
translated: ...Nhan tien, duoc roi, chung ta hay cung nhau tieu diet chung de hien te la co!

original: 剛才因大意受挫，這次不會了，要讓你們看看我的厲害．
translated: Vua roi toi buc boi vi su bat can cua minh, nhung lan nay toi se khong lam vay. Toi muon ban thay toi manh me nhu the nao.

original: 喂，還有沒有稍微有點骨氣的？唉，我跟你玩玩吧．
translated: Nay, co ai co chut xuong song khong? O, cho toi choi voi ban nhe.

original: 怎麼如此不中用啊．沒意思．
translated: Tai sao no lai vo dung nhu vay? Khong thu vi.

original: 不，不應該這麼不爭氣．
translated: Khong, no khong nen that vong nhu vay.

original: 你回去好啦，懶得和你交手．
translated: Ve di thoi, toi luoi dau voi anh qua.

original: 你這個傢伙！不要侮辱人！
translated: Anh ban! Dung xuc pham moi nguoi!

original: 哈哈，怎、怎麼樣……
translated: Haha, the nao, the nao...

original: ……你惹惱了我，別走！
translated: ...Anh lam toi buc minh day, dung di!

original: 噢噢！剛才敗了，這次也敗了．
translated: O o! Vua roi chung ta da bi danh bai, va lan nay chung ta cung da bi danh bai.

original: 主公，敵人那點兒兵力還真頑強啊，好像接近了我們．
translated: Thua ngai, quan dich that ngoan cuong. Co ve nhu ho dang tiep can chung toi.

original: 哎，他們也不是膿包．好，全軍開始進攻！！
translated: Nay, chung cung khong phai la mun mu. Duoc roi, toan quan bat dau tan cong! !

original: 主公，敵人就那點兒兵力還真頑強啊，好像接近了我們．
translated: Thua ngai, quan dich that ngoan cuong voi quan so it nhu vay. Co ve nhu anh ay dang den gan chung toi.

original: 主公，劉備想要奪取糧倉向我們營地出發了．
translated: Chua oi, Luu Bi muon chiem vua va dang tien ve phia trai cua chung ta.

original: 什麼！！劉備，你這招真狠啊！急速返回營地！
translated: Cai gi! ! Luu Bi, nguoi that doc ac! Hay nhanh chong quay ve trai!

original: 好！我們奪取了袁紹的糧倉．
translated: Tot! Ta chiem duoc vua Vien Thieu.

original: 噢，兄長．太棒了．
translated: O, anh trai. tuyet voi.

original: 這樣袁紹軍就沒有糧食了．
translated: Cu nhu vay quan Vien Thieu se khong co luong thuc.

original: 這仗我們贏定了．
translated: Chung ta chac chan se thang tran chien nay.

original: 唉，劉備這個混帳，你再晚來一步我就可以殺死公孫瓚了……媽的，我不會善罷干休！公孫瓚啊，敗軍之恨，總有一天要報的．全軍撤退！
translated: Than oi, Luu Bi, do khon nan, neu nguoi cham mot buoc ta da co the giet chet Cong Ton Zan... Me kiep, ta se khong buong tha! Gongsun Zan, long cam thu cua doi quan bai tran mot ngay nao do se duoc bao thu. Toan quan rut lui!

original: 繳獲黃金２００！
translated: 200 vang bi tich thu!

original: 公孫瓚，我不會認輸的！
translated: Gongsun Zan, toi se khong thua nhan that bai!

original: 劉備，你來的正好，這次多虧你來幫我們．
translated: Luu Bi, nguoi den vua luc, cam on nguoi da giup do chung ta lan nay.

original: 哪裡，因為及時趕到了，才能轉敗為勝．
translated: O dau, vi den kip thoi nen chung ta co the chuyen bai thanh thang.

original: 哦，對了．劉備，給你介紹一下，這位是趙雲，在我危難之際救了我．趙雲，這位是劉備．
translated: O, dung roi. Luu Bi, de toi gioi thieu voi cac ban, day la Trieu Van, nguoi da cuu toi khi toi gap nguy hiem. Trieu Van, day la Luu Bi.

original: 我叫劉備字玄德．
translated: Toi ten la Luu Bi, con goi la Huyen Duc.

original: 你就是劉備啊，大名如雷貫耳．我叫趙雲字子龍．
translated: Ban la Luu Bi, ten ban nhu sam set. Toi ten Trieu Van hay con goi la Tu Long.

original: 諸位，總之我們打了勝仗．為勝利，乾杯．
translated: Tat ca moi nguoi, tom lai, chung toi da thang tran. Chuc mung chien thang.

original: 第一章支援北海•徐州
translated: Chuong 1 Ung Ho Bac Hai • Xu Chau

original:
公孫瓚和袁紹的界橋之戰，由於劉備軍和趙雲的英勇善戰，公孫瓚高奏凱歌．
　
　
　
　可是由於連續幾個月的作戰，士兵非常疲憊．得知此事的董卓，想賣個人情，就以皇帝的名義勸兩人和好．正中兩人下懷，界橋之戰就這樣結束了．
translated:
Trong tran Cau Bien gioi giua Gongsun Zan va Vien Thieu, Gongsun Zan da hat mot bai ca khai hoan do tran chien anh dung cua quan Luu Bi va Trieu Van.
　
　
　
Tuy nhien, do nhieu thang chien dau lien tuc nen binh si rat met moi. Sau khi biet chuyen, Dong Trac muon ban sung nen nhan danh hoang de thuyet phuc hai nguoi hoa giai. Dieu nay da anh huong den tham vong cua hai nguoi, va Tran chien Cau Bien gioi da ket thuc nhu the nay.

original:
之後，在帝都發生了一件大事．呂布刺死了董卓．
　呂布中了王允和貂蟬兩人的連環計，刺死了董卓．隨後呂布在董卓舊部面前吃了敗仗，逃離了帝都．
translated:
Sau do, mot su kien lon da xay ra o kinh do. Lu Bo dam chet Dong Trac.
Lu Bo roi vao bay cua Vuong Van, Dieu Thuyen va dam chet Dong Trac. Sau nay, Lu Bo bai tran truoc quan cu cua Dong Trac va bo chay khoi kinh do.

original: 陳留議事廳
translated: Hoi quan Chenliu

original: n主公，大事不好！
translated: n Lay Chua, co chuyen chang lanh dang xay ra!

original: 吵鬧什麼？還會有比董卓死了更大的事嗎？急什麼．
translated: Co chuyen gi on ao vay? Con dieu gi lon hon chuyen Dong Trac chet? Co gi voi the?

original: n可是……
translated: n Nhung...

original: 平心靜氣講．
translated: Hay binh tinh noi chuyen.

original: n是，主公的父親曹嵩被陶謙部下殺害了．
translated: Dung vay, cha cua lanh chua la Cao Song da bi nguoi cua Tao Qian giet chet.

original: 什麼！？是真的嗎？
translated: Cai gi! ? Co dung khong?

original: 陶謙為什麼要殺我父親！為什麼！
translated: Tai sao Dao Khiem lai giet cha toi! Tai sao!

original: n根據報告說，令尊在來陳留途中，陶謙招待了他，還派護衛護送他．可是令尊慘遭那護衛殺害．
translated: n Theo bao cao, khi cha ban dang tren duong den Chenliu, Tao Qian da tiep dai ong ay va cu linh canh ho tong ong ay. Nhung cha cua ban da bi linh canh giet chet mot cach da man.

original: 唉……陶謙，我絕不饒你．于禁！
translated: Than oi... Tao Qian, toi se khong bao gio tha thu cho ban. Cam!

original: 你馬上率一軍直奔徐州，殺他們以祭父親在天之靈．我將隨後率兵到小沛．你打先鋒．
translated: Ban lien dan quan den Xu Chau va giet ho de te linh cha ban ve troi. Sau do ta se dan quan ve Tieu Bai. Ban di tien phong.

original: 是，倍感榮幸．我馬上奔徐州，取陶謙首級來見你．
translated: Vang, toi cam thay vinh du. Ta lap tuc chay den Xu Chau dem dau cua Dao Khiem den gap nguoi.

original: 我馬上殺往徐州，為令尊大人報仇．
translated: Ta se lap tuc di Xu Chau bao thu cho cha nguoi.

original: 陶謙老朽，我絕不饒你！進軍小沛！
translated: Dao Khiem, ta tuyet doi se khong tha cho nguoi! Tien vao Tieu Bach!

original: 大哥，徐州陶謙的家臣糜竺前來求見．說有話要對大哥講．
translated: Anh ca Xu Chau, thuoc ha cua Tao Qian la Mi Truc den xin yet kien. Toi co chuyen muon noi voi anh trai toi.

original: 他好像有什麼重要事要講．大哥快聽他講話吧．
translated: Hinh nhu anh ay co chuyen quan trong muon noi. Anh em hay nghe anh noi nhe.

original: 兄長先去和糜竺談話吧．
translated: Anh a, chung ta vao noi chuyen voi Mi Truc truoc nhe.

original: 劉備，初次見面，請多關照．我是陶謙的家臣，叫糜竺．
translated: Luu Bi, day la lan dau tien chung ta gap nhau, xin hay quan tam toi toi. Toi la thuoc ha cua Tao Qian, toi ten la Mi Truc.

original: 我和陶謙在討伐董卓的聯軍時也見過面，你這次來有什麼事情？
translated: Tao Qian va toi cung gap nhau khi dang chinh phuc lien quan o Dong Trac. Lan nay ban dang lam gi o day?

original: 其實此次前來是有求於劉備．
translated: Thuc ra toi den day la de nho Luu Bi giup do.

original: 是什麼事？
translated: No la gi vay?

original: 就在前兩天，曹操的父親經過徐州．我主公在徐州設宴招待了曹操父親，還派人護送．
translated: Moi hai ngay truoc, bo Tao Thao di ngang qua Xu Chau. Lanh chua to chuc tiec chieu dai cha Tao Thao o Xu Chau va sai nguoi ho tong.

original: 這不是很好嗎？
translated: Dieu nay khong tuyet voi sao?

original: 可是，那個護衛起了反心，殺死了曹操父親，掠去了財寶．曹操知道後驚怒異常，率領大軍攻打徐州．
translated: Tuy nhien, nguoi bao ve da noi loan, giet chet cha cua Tao Thao va lay di kho bau. Khi Tao Thao biet chuyen, ong vo cung tuc gian, dan quan tan cong Xu Chau.

original: 怎麼搞的嘛？原想歡迎，反倒成仇．
translated: Chuyen gi da xay ra the? Toi muon chao don ban, nhung cuoi cung toi lai tro nen thu dich.

original: 所說的有求於劉備就是這件事．可否發兵支援徐州？請您救我們，不，是救徐州．這樣下去的話，我們姑且不說連老百姓都捲進了戰爭．
translated: Day chinh la dieu toi mong muon o Luu Bi. Co the dua quan den ho tro Xu Chau duoc khong? Xin hay cuu chung toi, khong, cuu Xu Chau. Neu dieu nay tiep tuc, chu dung noi den dan thuong, chung ta se tham gia vao cuoc chien.

original: ……．明白了．你看我行的話就幫助你們．
translated: ……． Da hieu. Neu ban thay toi co the lam duoc gi, toi se giup ban.

original: 哦，謝謝，此恩終生難忘．
translated: Oi, cam on ban, toi se khong bao gio quen long tot nay.

original: 不客氣．你也長途奔波勞累了，去客房休息吧．
translated: Khong co gi. Di duong xa met moi nen ve phong nghi ngoi.

original: 謝謝，那失陪了．
translated: Cam on. Toi xin loi.

original: 大哥，要發兵支援的話，打曹操，我們兵力可不夠啊，怎麼辦？
translated: Anh oi, neu anh muon gui quan den ho tro chung toi, chung toi se chong lai Tao Thao. Chung ta khong co du quan. Chung ta nen lam gi?

original: 若發兵支援，抗拒曹操，我們現在沒有那麼多兵力啊．
translated: Neu dem quan di ho tro va chong lai Tao Thao thi bay gio chung ta khong co nhieu quan nhu vay.

original: 嗯，向公孫瓚借些兵吧．
translated: Duoc roi, hay muon mot it quan tu Gongsun Zan.

original: 這是個好主意．那麼我們快去公孫瓚所在地的北平城吧．
translated: Day la mot y tuong tot. Sau do chung ta hay den thanh pho Beiping noi Gongsun Zan toa lac.

original: 快去北平吧，北平位於平原的北面．
translated: Chung ta hay den Bac Binh. Peiping nam o phia bac cua dong bang.

original: 大哥，快去北平吧．
translated: Anh oi, hay den Bac Kinh nhanh len.

original: 哦，劉備，什麼風把你吹來了？
translated: Oi Luu Bi, con gio nao dua em den day?

original: 大哥，先跟公孫瓚打個招呼吧．
translated: Anh oi, xin hay chao Gongsun Zan truoc.

original: 我們沒事，但跟公孫瓚還是說一下好．
translated: Chung toi on, nhung tot hon het la nen noi chuyen voi Gongsun Zan.

original: 劉備，怎麼了．
translated: Luu Bi, co chuyen gi the?

original: 徐州陶謙派來使者，請求我支援．我想發兵前去支援，但是我這一點兵力恐怕不行．您看能不能借我一些兵？
translated: Xu Chau Tao Qian cu su gia den cau cuu toi. Muon phai quan den ho tro nhung lai so khong du quan. Ban co nghi rang ban co the cho toi muon mot so nguoi linh?

original: 劉備在界橋對我有相助之恩，我很高興借兵給你．
translated: Luu Bi da giup toi o Jieqiao. Toi rat vui khi duoc cho ban muon quan.

original: 那就帶他去吧．
translated: Sau do dua anh ta den do.

original: 您叫我嗎？
translated: Ban da goi cho toi phai khong?

original: 趙雲，你和劉備去支援徐州．
translated: Trieu Van, nguoi cung Luu Bi di ho tro Xu Chau.

original: 去徐州？
translated: Di Xu Chau?

original: 嗯，他們請求劉備支援．趙雲，我想派你同去．
translated: Thoi, ho nho Luu Bi ho tro. Trieu Van, anh muon gui em di cung.

original: 能和劉備一起作戰，我非常高興，我願意去．
translated: Toi rat vui khi duoc dau voi Luu Bi va san sang ra di.

original: 那麼，趙雲讓你辛苦一趟，劉備，祝你成功．
translated: Thoi Trieu Van, cam on ban da lam viec cham chi, Luu Bi, chuc ban thanh cong.

original: 祝你勝利．
translated: Chuc ban chien thang.

original: 劉備，我一直在等你．請你準備出兵．
translated: Luu Bi, toi dang doi cau day. Hay chuan bi gui quan di.

original: 兄長，糜竺在等我們．
translated: Anh oi, Mi Truc dang doi chung ta.

original: 大哥，糜竺等得著急了．
translated: Anh oi, Mi Truc dang nong long cho doi.

original: 主公，聽你吩咐．
translated: Thua ngai, toi nghe lenh cua ngai.

original: 那麼快往徐州吧．
translated: Sau do hay di ve Xu Chau that nhanh.

original: 徐州在這個平原的南面，快速行軍吧．
translated: Xu Chau. Ve phia nam cua dong bang nay, hay hanh quan nhanh chong.

original: 嗯？好像情況不對啊，怎麼回事？
translated: Um? Co dieu gi do co ve khong on. Chuyen gi dang xay ra vay?

original: 哈哈哈，進攻進攻！再攻一會兒城池就歸我了．
translated: Hahaha, tan cong, tan cong! Sau mot thoi gian tan cong, thanh pho se la cua toi.

original: 再這樣的話，北海就要被攻陷了，孔融，請你出城逃走吧．
translated: Neu cu tiep tuc nhu vay, Bac Hai se bi chiem. Kong Rong, xin hay roi khoi thanh pho va tron thoat.

original: 不，這不行！我雖不願意看到城池陷落，但我更不願意棄城逃走．
translated: Khong, dieu nay se khong hieu qua! Mac du toi khong muon nhin thay thanh pho sup do, nhung toi cang khong muon tu bo thanh pho va chay tron.

original: 衝啊！衝啊！金銀財寶就在那裡！
translated: Di! Di! Kho bau vang va bac o do!

original: 看來好像是草寇作亂．
translated: Co ve nhu bon cuop co dang gay rac roi.

original: 這裡是北海，是孔融治理的地方．
translated: Day la Bac Hai, noi Kong Rong cai tri.

original: 是孔融啊，孔融也參加了反董卓的聯軍啊．
translated: Do la Khong Dung. Khong Dung cung tham gia lien minh chong Dong Trac.

original: 主公，怎麼辦？就這樣置之不理嗎？
translated: Lay Chua, con phai lam gi? Chi can bo qua no?

original: 不，不能這樣置之不理．糜竺，對不起，要繞些路了．
translated: Khong, ban khong the bo qua no nhu the nay. Mi Truc, xin loi, chung ta phai di duong vong.

original: 沒辦法，沒有你劉備這樣好的人．
translated: Khong co cach nao, khong co nguoi nao tot nhu ban Luu Bi.

original: 不愧是劉備，他才是我佩服的人．
translated: Dung nhu mong doi cua Luu Bi, anh ay la nguoi ma toi nguong mo.

original: 哈哈哈．這個城就等於到手了．混蛋們，把城裡的金銀財寶統統給我拿來．
translated: Hahaha. Thanh pho nay tuong duong voi viec duoc mua lai. Do khon, hay mang cho toi tat ca vang bac trong thanh pho.

original: 難道我就這樣完了．
translated: Day co phai la ket thuc cua toi?

original: 只因我們軍力不足．嗯，我們有救了．
translated: Chi vi suc manh quan su cua chung ta khong du. Vang, chung toi da duoc cuu.

original: 大哥，再不快點，這個城就落到山賊手裡啦．
translated: Anh oi, neu anh khong nhanh len, thanh pho nay se roi vao tay bon cuop.

original: 山賊竟敢襲擊城鎮，膽子好大啊，碰上我們算他運氣不好．
translated: Ten cuop dam tan cong thi tran. Anh ay that dung cam. Anh ay that khong may man khi gap phai chung toi.

original: 好，刻不容緩，消滅山賊．
translated: Duoc roi, hay loai bo bon cuop ngay lap tuc.

original: 嗯？你們是幹什麼的？想和我們作對嗎？哈哈哈，有意思．笨蛋們，調過頭來打，給他們點苦頭．
translated: Um? Ban lam nghe gi? Muon chong lai chung toi? Hahaha, thu vi. Do ngoc, hay quay lai va chien dau va cho ho chut dau don.

original: 那是山賊的大將，在劉備面前也顯示一下我的本領．
translated: Do la tuong cua bon cuop. Hay de toi the hien ky nang cua minh truoc mat Luu Bi.

original: 哎呀，哈哈哈，真是蠢貨，好像他還覺得能打贏我，沒辦法，我就陪你玩玩吧．
translated: Oi, hahaha, dung la do ngoc, hinh nhu anh ta tuong co the danh bai duoc toi, toi cung khong lam gi duoc, chi choi voi anh thoi.

original: 我是管亥，讓你去陰曹地府……
translated: Ta la Quan Hai, ta muon nguoi di dia nguc...

original: 有破綻．
translated: Co nhung sai sot.

original: 啊！
translated: a!

original: 豈能寬容你這坑害百姓的草寇．
translated: Lam sao toi co the dung thu cho anh, mot ten cuop co chuyen hai dan?

original: 趙雲殺了管亥，劉備軍打敗了草寇．
translated: Trieu Van giet Quan Hai, quan cua Lu Bi danh tan bon cuop co.

original: 倒霉！你們再晚一點來，這個城就成我的了．
translated: That may man! Neu ban den muon hon mot chut, thanh pho nay se la cua toi.

original: 主公，不知道來的是什麼人，但我們現在應該殺出去配合他們．
translated: Lay Chua, con khong biet ai se den, nhung chung ta nen ra ngoai va hop tac voi ho ngay bay gio.

original: 唉，好．打開城門！我們也殺出去．
translated: Than oi, tot. Mo cong thanh! Hay cung chien dau nhe.

original: 繳獲黃金３００！
translated: 300 vang bi tich thu!

original: 雖素不相識，但深感大德，能否請教尊姓大名．
translated: Du chung ta la nhung nguoi xa la nhung toi vo cung tran trong duc tinh cao ca cua ban. Ban co the vui long cho toi biet ho cua ban duoc khong?

original: 我叫劉備．
translated: Toi ten la Luu Bi.

original: 噢，您就是平原的劉備啊．救我於危難之際，非常感謝，請您一定要進城，也請您見一下孔融．
translated: O, ban la Luu Bi den tu Binh Nguyen. Cam on ban rat nhieu vi da cuu toi gap nguy hiem. Hay den thanh pho va gap Kong Rong.

original: 北海議事廳
translated: Hoi quan Bac Hai

original: 主公，我把劉備請出來了．
translated: Chua oi, con da moi Luu Bi ra ngoai.

original: 噢，劉備．你救了北海，太感謝了．
translated: Oi Luu Bi. Ban da cuu duoc Bac Hai, cam on ban rat nhieu.

original: 孔融感激不盡．
translated: Kong Rong rat biet on.

original: 不用多禮．我們這是因糜竺請求，正在趕往徐州．
translated: Khong can phai lich su. Chung toi dang gap rut di Xu Chau theo yeu cau cua Mi Truc.

original: 去徐州？去支援嗎？我也聽說曹操在攻打徐州．
translated: Di Xu Chau? Di ho tro? Ta con nghe noi Tao Thao dang tan cong Xu Chau.

original: 是的．我們路過這裡時發現太史慈正受到攻擊，所以助他一臂之力．
translated: Dung. Khi di ngang qua, chung toi thay Thai Su Tu dang bi tan cong nen ra tay giup do.

original: 是嗎？那樣的話，我撥給你一些糧草，也表示一下對這次幫助的感謝．
translated: Vang? Trong truong hop do, toi se phan bo mot so luong thuc va co cho ban va bay to long biet on ve su giup do nay.

original: 大哥，再不趕路就要誤事啦．
translated: Anh oi, neu khong nhanh len, anh se bo lo dieu gi do.

original: 是啊．那麼，孔融，我們還急著趕路，告辭了．
translated: Dung. Thoi, Kong Rong, chung ta van dang voi noi loi tam biet.

original: 祝你馬到成功．
translated: Chuc ban thanh cong ngay lap tuc.

original: 非常感謝．
translated: Cam on ban rat nhieu.

original: 準備出征．
translated: Chuan bi tham chien.

original: 努力啊．
translated: Lam viec cham chi.

original: 謝謝你，有劉備支援，徐州就萬無一失了．
translated: Cam on nguoi, co su ho tro cua Luu Bi, Xu Chau se duoc an toan.

original: 快去徐州吧．
translated: Ve Xu Chau nhanh nhe.

original: 劉備，徐州在北海的南面，快去吧．
translated: Luu Bi va Xu Chau o phia nam Bac Hai. Di nhanh len.

original: 說什麼？劉備攻過來了？有多少兵？……不好．一定設法等夏侯淵的到來．
translated: noi gi co? Luu Bi toi? Co bao nhieu nguoi linh? ……khong tot. Chung ta phai co gang doi Ha Hau Vien den.

original: 大家快走，去支援于禁！
translated: Moi nguoi nhanh tay den ung ho Yu Jin nhe!

original: 敵人的援軍已來到附近．我們不要戀戰，快進徐州城吧．
translated: Quan tiep vien cua dich da den gan do. Chung ta khong muon danh nhau thi nhanh chong tien vao thanh Xu Chau.

original: 劉備，遵孔融之命，太史慈前來助你．
translated: Luu Bi, theo lenh Khong Dung, Thai Su Tu toi giup nguoi.

original: 好，放他進徐州城．大家不要打硬仗，退進城去．
translated: Duoc roi, de han vao thanh Xu Chau. Moi nguoi dung danh tran kho khan, hay rut lui vao thanh pho.

original: 太棒了，大哥．
translated: That tuyet voi, anh trai.

original: 趁敵人援軍沒到之前，我們快進城吧．

original: 得到黃金３００！

original: 我就是關羽關雲長，有武將的話就出來．
translated: Toi la Quan Vu Quan Van Xuong. Neu co tuong thi toi se ra.

original: 無名小卒休得猖狂，我來了．
translated: Khong ai co the kieu ngao nhu vay, toi den day.

translated: Ong xung dang lam tuong quan cua Tao Thao. Chi la nguoi khong the danh bai ta bang vo cong cua minh ma thoi.

original: 情況不妙！關羽，我記住你了．

translated: Leu trai quan su Tao Thao

original: 對不起．雖然讓我當先鋒，可是沒打好……

original: 我不想聽你道歉．為什麼沒捉到陶謙？我軍不應該敗給陶謙．
translated: Toi khong muon nghe loi xin loi cua ban. Tai sao Tao Qian khong bi bat? Quan doi cua chung ta khong nen bi Tao Qian danh bai.

original: 什麼！那個劉備嗎？唉，可是劉備為什麼支援陶謙呢？
translated: Cai gi! Luu Bi do ha? Than oi, nhung tai sao Luu Bi lai ung ho Dao Khiem?

original: 這個我一點也不知道．

original: 嗯，既然幫助陶謙，那麼劉備也是敵人！我絕不寬恕！這次我親自出征．
translated: Duoc roi, vi da giup do Tao Qian nen Luu Bi cung la ke thu! Toi se khong bao gio tha thu! Lan nay toi se dich than di ra ngoai.

original: 我回來了．

original: 哦，糜竺，這次你勸說劉備勸得好．劉備，久違了．
translated: Oi Mi Truc, lan nay ban thuyet phuc duoc Luu Bi rat tot day. Luu Bi, da lau khong gap.

original: 我們能來得及支援，太好了．
translated: That tuyet voi khi chung toi co the ho tro ban kip thoi.

original: 呀，大哥，時間好緊啊，再晚一點就危險了．
translated: U, anh ban, thoi gian eo hep qua. Se rat nguy hiem neu ban den muon hon.

original: 劉備，太謝謝你了．
translated: Luu Bi Cam on ban nhieu nhe.

original: 如果劉備不來，我們都要遭殺身之禍．
translated: Luu Bi khong toi thi chung ta deu bi giet.

original: 可是，雖然初戰告捷，但敵人很強大，他們不會就此罷休的．
translated: Tuy nhien, mac du ho da gianh chien thang trong tran chien dau tien nhung ke thu rat manh va ho se khong bo cuoc.

original: 曹操軍肯定還會打來，怎麼辦？
translated: Quan Tao Thao nhat dinh se lai den, chung ta phai lam sao?

original: 曹操是個頭腦清醒、明白事理的人，我們請求他停戰吧．
translated: Tao Thao la nguoi co dau oc sang suot va nhay ben. Hay yeu cau anh ta cham dut chien tranh.

original: 可是事情能否那麼順利呢？
translated: Nhung lieu moi chuyen co the dien ra suon se nhu vay?

original: 試一試看，不行再說．這交給我好啦．
translated: Hay thu va xem no co hoat dong khong. Hay de viec nay cho toi.

original: 我認為應出兵作戰，只有作戰才能稱為武將．
translated: Toi tin rang quan doi nen duoc gui di chien dau. Chi co chien dau moi co the duoc goi la tuong quan.

original: 哎，關羽，少見呀．竟比我還想打仗．
translated: Nay, Quan Vu, hiem lam. Anh ay thuc su muon chien dau nhieu hon toi.

original: 只有和強敵交鋒才能稱為武將．敵人是曹操軍的話，豈不正合我意．兄長，是派張飛去求和，還是作戰，你想選擇哪個？請兄長決定！你想好的話，跟張飛或我說一下．
translated: Chi co chien dau chong lai ke thu manh moi co the duoc goi la tuong quan. Neu ke dich la quan Tao Thao thi chang phai chinh la dieu minh mong muon sao? Anh em muon chon ben nao, phai Truong Phi di kien hoa hay dau? Anh em hay quyet dinh nhe! Neu ban nghi ky thi hay noi chuyen voi Truong Phi hoac toi.

original: 曹操軍非常強大，以正面與他交鋒是下策．還是派張飛去求和吧．
translated: Quan doi cua Tao Thao rat hung manh, doi dau truc dien voi han la mot y tuong toi. Tot nhat la phai Truong Phi di kien de hoa giai.

original: 我選擇交戰．盡管對方強大，但我方在士氣上沒有輸．
translated: Toi chon chien dau. Du doi thu rat manh nhung tinh than cua chung toi van khong he suy giam.

original: 敵軍強大，他們是不會善罷甘休的．還是派張飛去求和吧．
translated: Ke thu rat manh va ho se khong bo cuoc. Tot nhat la phai Truong Phi di kien de hoa giai.

original: 莫非要我投降才是上策？
translated: Co le dieu tot nhat toi nen lam la dau hang?

original: 哦，兄長，決定出征了嗎？
translated: O, anh ban, anh da quyet dinh di tham hiem chua?

original: 快做出征準備吧．
translated: Hay nhanh chong san sang cho cuoc tham hiem.

original: 快出征吧．
translated: Hay nhanh chong tham chien.

original: 既然你們決定了，我們也出征．聽說敵人現在在小沛．
translated: Bay gio ban da quyet dinh, chung ta se di tham hiem. Nghe noi dich bay gio dang o Tieu Bai.

original: 從這裡向西南，有個地方叫小沛．曹操軍就在那裡扎營．
translated: Ve phia Tay Nam tu day co mot noi goi la Tieu Bai. Quan Tao Thao dong trai o do.

original: 曹操軍有什麼了不起？兄長，快進軍小沛吧．
translated: Quan Tao Thao co gi tuyet voi? Anh em hay nhanh chong hanh quan den Tieu Bai nhe.

original: 大哥，派我去向曹操軍求和嗎？
translated: Anh oi, anh sai em di cau hoa voi quan Tao Thao duoc khong?

original: 這樣決定了的話就簡單了．好，我馬上就去．
translated: Mot khi da quyet dinh theo cach nay thi moi chuyen se de dang. Duoc roi toi se di ngay.

original: 劉備小兒，與我仇敵為友，我絕不寬恕你．殺盡劉備軍．
translated: Luu Bi, con oi, me se khong bao gio tha thu cho con vi da lam ban voi ke thu cua me. Giet het quan Luu Bi.

original: 曹操軍確實是大軍啊．但是以我們的士氣也不會輸給他們．大哥，現在拼死應戰吧．
translated: Quan Tao Thao qua thuc la mot doi quan dong dao. Nhung voi tinh than cua minh, chung toi se khong thua ho. Anh em oi, hay chien dau den chet ngay bay gio.

original: 出來一戰吧！廢話少說！有膽子的出來．
translated: Hay ra ngoai va chien dau! Dung noi nham nua! Hay ra ngoai neu ban du can dam.

original: 相當威風啊，我去戰他吧．
translated: Anh ay kha hoanh trang. Hay de toi chien dau voi anh ta.

original: 走！
translated: Di bo!

original: 看槍！
translated: Nhin vao khau sung!

original: 你也吃我一刀．
translated: Ban cung dam toi.

original: 再來一刺，接著．
translated: Vay them mot nhat nua nhe.

original: 噯，好厲害．勝不了他．
translated: Nay, that tuyet voi. Khong the danh bai anh ta.

original: 要逃嗎，太狡猾了．乾脆認輸吧．
translated: Ban co muon tron thoat khong? Ban qua xao quyet. Hay tu bo di.

original: 哼，這種戰鬥力還能打仗嗎？再狠狠地給我殺．
translated: Hu, voi suc chien dau nhu the nay chung ta con co the chien dau duoc khong? Giet toi manh hon di.

original: 不陪你們玩了，眾將士，全面出擊！
translated: Ta khong choi voi cac nguoi nua, toan quan, toan luc tan cong!

original: 噯，不愧是曹操軍……
translated: Nay, qua nhien la Tao Thao quan...

original: 什麼！陳留遭呂布偷襲！壞了，忘了呂布的事．噯，沒辦法．全軍撤退！陶謙、劉備暫且留著你們的命！
translated: Cai gi! Tran Luu bi Lu Bo tan cong! Xau, quen Lu Bo di. A, khong co cach nao ca. Toan quan rut lui! Tao Qian, Luu Bi, xin hay tha mang cho bay gio!

original: 混蛋！再組織進攻！什麼！陳留遭呂布偷襲！壞了！看來使陳留防守空虛是下策．噯……沒辦法．全軍撤退！陶謙、劉備暫且留著你們的命！
translated: thang khon! To chuc mot cuoc tan cong khac! Cai gi! Tran Luu bi Lu Bo tan cong! vo! Co ve nhu de trong hang phong ngu cua Chen Liu la mot y tuong toi. A...khong the nao. Toan quan rut lui! Tao Qian, Luu Bi, xin hay tha mang cho bay gio!

original: 得到黃金３００．
translated: Nhan 300 vang.

original: 全軍馬上折回，保住陳留！快！
translated: Toan quan lap tuc quay lai cuu Tran Luu! nhanh!

original: 噯？曹操怎麼突然逃跑了？
translated: Ai? Tai sao Tao Thao lai dot nhien bo chay?

original: 不知道．不過，徐州得救可是真的．先回徐州吧．
translated: khong co y tuong Tuy nhien, dung la Xu Chau da duoc cuu. Chung ta hay quay lai Xu Chau truoc.

original: p主公，不得了啦．呂布進攻陳留了．
translated: p Lay Chua, dieu nay that khong the tin duoc. Lu Bo tan cong Tran Luu.

original: 什麼？怎麼會這樣．壞了，太大意了．呂布這個畜生，乘我不在來偷襲．
translated: Cai gi? sao vay. Hong roi, bat can qua. Lu Bo, con thu nay loi dung luc toi vang mat de tan cong toi.

original: 張飛？劉備的那個盟弟呀．劉備請求停戰？噯，真是天助我也．告訴張飛，我接受停戰．好，快速返回陳留，把呂布從陳留趕出去．
translated: Truong Phi? Dong minh cua Luu Bi. Luu Bi xin dinh chien? Dung la Chua dang giup toi. Noi voi Truong Phi la toi chap nhan dinh chien. Duoc roi, nhanh chong quay lai Chenliu va duoi Lu Bo ra khoi Chenliu.

original: 不能讓呂布把陳留奪去．快速返回！
translated: Chung ta khong the de Lu Bo dua Chen Liu di. Tro lai nhanh chong!

original: 不過，曹操為什麼撤退了？要是我的話就絕對進攻啦．
translated: Nhung tai sao Tao Thao lai rut lui? Neu la toi chac chan toi se tan cong.

original: 不知道，可是徐州得救是實實在在的．還是回城吧．
translated: Khong biet nhung su cuu roi cua Xu Chau la co that. Chung ta hay quay tro lai thanh pho.

original: 劉備，這次你實在幫了大忙．
translated: Luu Bi, lan nay cau thuc su da giup toi rat nhieu.

translated: Khong, chung toi chang giup duoc gi ca, chi la Tao Thao quay lai ma thoi.

original: 不不，來支援我們的只有你，我現在心情非常高興．
translated: Khong, khong, ban la nguoi duy nhat den ung ho chung toi. Bay gio toi rat hanh phuc.

original: 謝謝，這樣徐州得救了．
translated: Cam on Xu Chau da duoc cuu roi.

original: 劉備，謝謝．

original: 能有今天多虧了劉備．
translated: Toi co duoc ngay hom nay la nho Luu Bi.

original: 徐州得救太好了．
translated: That tuyet voi khi Xu Chau duoc cuu.

original: 還是幫助別人心裡舒服．
translated: Hoac giup nguoi khac cam thay tot hon.

original: 劉備，這是我的一點心意，請你收下．
translated: Luu Bi day la tam su cua minh mot chut, mong ban tiep nhan.

original: 這是？
translated: Day la?

original: 這是我們徐州自古傳下來的兵器，叫雌雄雙劍．
translated: Day la loai vu khi duoc Xu Chau truyen lai tu xa xua, goi la kiem nam nu.

original: 您是說把這樣貴重的東西給我？
translated: Y cua nguoi la cho ta mot vat quy gia nhu vay?

original: 我們拿著他也沒有意義，因為不能熟練使用，我希望把劍送給真正有用的人使用，請您一定收下．
translated: Giu anh ta cung chang ich gi vi chung ta khong the su dung no mot cach kheo leo. Toi hy vong co the trao thanh kiem nay cho nguoi thuc su huu ich. Hay chap nhan no.

original: 劉備，其實我有事相託．
translated: Luu Bi, that ra toi co chuyen muon hoi cau.

original: 只要我能辦到的就一定全力以赴，請您吩咐．
translated: Chi can co the lam duoc, toi se co gang het suc. Xin vui long cho toi don dat hang cua ban.

original: 謝謝，我想把小沛託給你治理．
translated: Cam on ban, toi xin giao cho ban quan ly Tieu Bai.

original: 什麼？我這樣的人實在擔不起如此大任．
translated: Cai gi? Mot nguoi nhu toi thuc su khong the dam duong duoc trach nhiem lon lao nhu vay.

original: 不，這是要臣們商量的結果，希望你能幫助徐州的百姓，請接受吧．
translated: Khong, day la ket qua thao luan giua cac bo truong. Toi hy vong ban co the giup do nguoi dan Xu Chau. Hay chap nhan no.

original: 我明白，那就恭敬不如從命了．
translated: Toi hieu, the thi tha tuan lenh con hon la ton trong.

original: 您接受了，好，你帶孫乾去，孫乾很有才幹，你可以用他．
translated: Neu chap nhan thi duoc, nguoi dem Ton Thien di cung. Sun Qian rat tai nang va ban co the su dung anh ay.

original: 小沛就拜託你們了．
translated: Tieu Bach se de lai cho ban.

original: 帶孫乾去小沛好啦．
translated: Dua Ton Tiem den Tieu Bai. Duoc roi.

original: 大哥，那就去小沛吧．
translated: Anh oi chung ta di Tieu Bai thoi.

original: 劉備，不，主公，今後請多關照．
translated: Luu Bi, khong, chua oi, sau nay hay cham soc toi that tot nhe.

original: 馬上去小沛吧，小沛是徐州西南的一個小鎮．
translated: Hay toi Tieu Bai ngay thoi. Tieu Bai la mot thi tran nho phia Tay Nam Xu Chau.

original: 我帶你們去小沛．
translated: Toi se dua ban den Tieu Bai.

original: 與趙雲等探討今後之事．
translated: Thao luan ve tuong lai voi Trieu Van va nhung nguoi khac.

original: 大哥，城主說我們接受此城太好了，這樣我們也有城了．
translated: Anh a, thanh chu noi se rat tot neu chung ta tiep nhan thanh pho nay nen chung ta cung co mot thanh pho.

original: 兄長，我們都很高興，終於有了一個自己的城．
translated: Anh a, chung ta deu rat hanh phuc, cuoi cung chung ta cung co duoc thanh pho cua rieng minh.

original: 主公，今後請多關照．
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay cham soc con that tot trong tuong lai.

original: 劉備，徐州之圍好像已解，我想回公孫瓚那裡．
translated: Cuoc bao vay Luu Bi, Xu Chau coi nhu da duoc giai quyet. Toi muon quay lai Gongsun Zan.

original: 是嗎？趙雲，這次你幫了大忙，我相信我們還能在一起為朝廷出力．
translated: Vang? Trieu Van, lan nay nguoi da giup do rat nhieu roi. Toi tin rang chung ta van co the cung nhau dong gop cho toa an.

original: 趙雲，希望再見到你．
translated: Trieu Van, hen gap lai.

original: 你雖不像我這樣厲害，但也相當了不起，希望還能見到你．
translated: Mac du ban khong manh me bang toi nhung ban van kha tuyet voi. Toi mong duoc gap lai ban.

original: 不勝感謝，我也還想和大家在一起建功立業，請多珍重．
translated: Cảm on rát nhièu. Toi cung muon dat duoc nhung thanh tuu to lon cung voi tat ca cac ban. Xin hay cham soc toi.

original: 今晚是趙雲的歡送會，喝！
translated: Toi nay la tiec chia tay Trieu Van, uong di!

original: 第一章　餓虎呂布來訪
translated: Chuong 1 Ho Doi Lu Bo Den Tham

original: 劉備在小沛落腳時，呂布和曹操正在陳留打仗，呂布想拿下陳留，作為自己的落腳之處．可是，最初的形勢雖然對呂布有利，但在曹操的計謀下，呂布又吃了敗仗，呂布軍又成了流浪軍．
translated: Khi Luu Bi dinh cu o Tieu Bai thi Lu Bo va Tao Thao dang danh nhau o Tran Lieu. Lu Bo muon chiem Chenliu lam can cu cua minh. Tuy nhien, tuy tinh the ban dau thuan loi cho Lu Bo nhung do am muu cua Tao Thao, Lu Bo lai phai chiu mot that bai khac, quan Lu Bo lai tro thanh doi quan lang thang.

original: 小沛議事廳
translated: Phong Tieu Bai

original: 大哥，曹操打敗了呂布，呂布好像四處流浪．
translated: Dai ca, Tao Thao danh bai Lu Bo, Lu Bo duong nhu dang lang thang khap noi.

original: 他活該，這是對他以前在漢都花天酒地的報應．
translated: Anh ay xung dang voi dieu do. Day la qua bao cho hanh vi truy lac truoc day cua anh ta o Handu.

original: 可是，呂布今後怎麼辦呢？他又沒有自己的領地．
translated: Nhung sau nay Lu Bo se lam gi? Anh ta khong co lanh tho cua rieng minh.

original: 主公，我視察完城內回來了．
translated: Chua oi, toi da tro lai sau khi kiem tra thanh pho.

original: 大哥，請聽簡雍彙報．
translated: Anh oi, xin hay nghe bao cao cua Jian Yong.

original: 據城內百姓說，小沛這個地方經常有山賊出沒．
translated: Theo loi ke cua nguoi dan trong thanh, Tieu Bai thuong xuyen bi bon cuop am anh.

original: 是這樣沒錯，我們也幾次想掃平這群山賊．
translated: Dung vay. Chung toi da co gang tieu diet bon cuop nay nhieu lan.

original: 我們來此地時間尚短，要想得到民心，其中之一就是掃平附近的山賊．
translated: Chung toi moi den day duoc mot thoi gian ngan va mot trong nhung cach chung toi muon chiem duoc cam tinh cua nguoi dan la tieu diet bon cuop gan do.

original: 正是，那麼草寇躲在哪裡？孫乾，你知道些什麼？
translated: Chinh xac thi bon cuop co dang tron o dau? Ton Thien, nguoi biet cai gi?

original: 山賊躲在泰山､夏丘､彭城三個地方．
translated: Bon cuop dang an nau o ba noi: Thai Son, Ha Thu va Banh Thanh.

original: 是泰山､夏丘､彭城，好，出兵去掃平山賊．
translated: Do la Thai Son, Ha Thu va Banh Thanh. Duoc roi, hay phai quan di tieu diet bon cuop.

original: 大哥，作出征準備吧．
translated: Anh em hay chuan bi cho cuoc tham hiem.

original: 大哥，快出征吧，幾個毛賊要是遇到我，不費吹灰之力就可以收拾他們．
translated: Anh em hay nhanh tay ra tran. Neu mot vai ten trom gap phai toi, toi co the xu ly chung ma khong can ton nhieu cong suc.

original: 盡管是山賊草寇，也不可大意，敗給他們可難堪了．
translated: Du ho la ke cuop, ke cuop, chung ta cung khong nen bat can. Se that xau ho neu thua ho.

original: 不能讓山賊草寇如此猖獗，平賊刻不容緩．
translated: Chung ta khong the de tho phi, tho phi tran lan, khong can phai tri hoan.

original: 大哥，去哪裡？
translated: Anh oi, anh di dau the?
